claim_boundary: This one-acetone gas-phase MACE-MDP coefficient comparison is a no-runtime-QM physical screen only. MACE-MDP supplies published frozen dipole/polarizability coefficients, not an energy or force. The calculation invokes no continuum, PCM, implicit solvent, experimental solvation value, target calibration, force/PES certificate, total-solvation prediction, or public Route-2 profile. A pass can admit only the separate construction and testing of a new explicit moment-space scalar; it cannot establish chemical accuracy.

candidate_identity.checkpoint_role: published frozen organic molecular dipole and fully anisotropic polarizability predictor
candidate_identity.strict_role_boundary: The MACE-MDP output is not interpreted as an energy gradient, a self-consistent density, a PCM source, a force, or a direct V0 functional. Its polarizability can only be considered later as a frozen coefficient in a newly declared scalar after this screen and separate energy-conjugate source-map, continuum, derivative, and force gates.

protocol.system: The frozen acetone geometry and omegaB97M-V/def2-TZVPD finite-field polarizability already sealed in route2-v0-qeq-acetone-qm-field-v1.json.
protocol.candidate_evaluation: Run the official MACECalculator with the frozen MACE-MDP checkpoint once at that exact geometry and read its direct dipole and 3x3 polarizability properties. There is no finite applied field and no claim that the checkpoint supplies a field-dependent energy.
protocol.polarizability_source_unit: e angstrom^2 / volt, as documented by the MACE-MDP repository
protocol.raw_tensor_rule: All acceptance comparisons use the raw converted model tensor. The canonical 0.5*(alpha+alpha^T) tensor may be recorded only after the raw antisymmetry gate passes, exclusively as a machine-precision representation for eigenvalue diagnostics and a possible later scalar definition; it cannot repair a failed response.
protocol.permanent_dipole_rule: The direct MACE-MDP dipole is recorded only as a non-gating source-interface diagnostic. No permanent PCM source is selected by this screen; any later c0(R) must have its own exact energy-conjugate density/source-map evidence.

numerical_gates.interpretation: A failure means the checkpoint output cannot serve unchanged as the positive symmetric linear-response coefficient of the proposed scalar. Do not symmetrize, shift, clip, or rescale it to recover eligibility.

scientific_falsification_gates.interpretation: These are the pre-existing gross gas-response rejection gates already used for V0-Q against the fixed omegaB97M-V/def2-TZVPD acetone finite-field reference. They test whether this frozen polarizability is physically plausible enough to justify a later functional construction, not implicit-solvation accuracy.

decision_rule: If any numerical or scientific gate fails, reject frozen MACE-MDP as a response-coefficient source for Route 2V0. Do not alter the tensor, add a correction, fit to a solvation value, change the geometry/reference/gates, select a cavity, or run an accuracy panel. If all gates pass, admit only a separately preregistered explicit moment-space scalar with an energy-conjugate permanent-source/induced-dipole map, common variational continuum functional, coordinate derivatives, and force/PES gates. The direct MACE-MDP head remains non-energy/non-force in either outcome.

preexecution_disclosure.prior_noncanonical_loader_smoke: Before this formal preregistration, an unregistered local source-interface smoke loaded the official checkpoint through the generic MACECalculator and inspected output shape/units on the same frozen geometry. It did not create a committed artifact or an admission decision. This disclosure prevents treating that loader check as a hidden preregistered result.
preexecution_disclosure.threshold_provenance: Every scientific threshold above is copied unchanged from the earlier frozen QEq acetone protocol, whose preregistration predates discovery of this generic MACE-MDP loader. No threshold was selected from MACE-MDP output.
